card.line: Moab is a region east of the Jordan and the Dead Sea, where Israel made its last camp before Canaan and where Moses died.

moments.title: Balak Fears Israel
moments.text: Israel camped in the plains of Moab, and Moab was terrified because the people were so many. King Balak sent for Balaam to curse Israel, but God told Balaam not to go, because Israel was blessed.

moments.title: Sin at Shittim
moments.text: While Israel stayed in Shittim, the men joined the daughters of Moab in sin and bowed down to their gods. The LORD's anger burned, and a plague killed 24,000 people.

moments.title: Moses Explains the Law
moments.text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, the LORD's commandments were given to Israel through Moses. In the land of Moab, east of the Jordan, Moses began to explain this law to the people.

moments.title: Moses Dies
moments.text: Moses climbed from the plains of Moab up Mount Nebo, where the LORD showed him the promised land. He died there in Moab, and the Israelites mourned him for thirty days.
